deployments_detail.use: AI analyst video avatars using OpenAI + Synthesia to deliver investment insights to clients (UBS disclosed, May 2025)

AI-generated video avatars of research analysts — analysts' likeness and voice cloned to turn written research notes into short-form client video, scaling video output beyond studio capacity. [OpenAI + Synthesia]
deployments_detail.value: 36 of ~720 analysts opted in; aims to close gap between ~1,000 videos and ~50,000 documents produced annually; 30-40% faster production

deployments_detail.use: STAAT Insights — proprietary AI-driven engine delivering pre-meeting insights and opportunity identification for US financial advisors to prepare for client meetings. [UBS proprietary]
deployments_detail.value: ~80% of US advisors actively using; contributes to ~10,000 advisor hours saved per month

deployments_detail.use: AI wealth platform for personalized investment insights & portfolio recommendations (Zurich tech centre)
Amelia conversational AI agent piloted for back-office / IT and customer-service support, answering employee and client support queries in natural language. [IPsoft / SoundHound (Amelia)]

UBS Red — in-house AI assistant giving client advisors instant access to investment insights, product information and market intelligence during client interactions; multi-language. [Microsoft Azure (Azure OpenAI Service + Azure AI Search)]
deployments_detail.value: Deployed to ~30,000 employees across 4-5 divisions; booking centres in Switzerland, Hong Kong, Singapore

deployments_detail.use: UBS Global Research 'AI Powered Analyst' — generative AI embedded across the research value chain for new product creation, client engagement and internal collaboration; won 2026 Model Sell Side Award for GenAI Automation. [Microsoft + Jupyter + Synthesia]

Microsoft 365 Copilot rolled out firm-wide (50,000 licenses) for employee productivity — described as the largest M365 Copilot deployment in financial services; subsequently expanded to all employees in cloud-enabled locations. [Microsoft (M365 Copilot)]

Legal AI Assistant (LAIA) — natural-language / semantic search across the bank's legal document corpus, letting employees locate clauses, phrases and paragraphs by meaning rather than keywords, with document-level access controls. [Microsoft Azure (Azure OpenAI Service + Azure AI Search)]
deployments_detail.value: Search across ~26 million legal documents; multi-language

deployments_detail.use: Automated meeting summaries and CRM updates plus advisor-specific chatbots answering questions on branch guidelines and procedures; automated meeting-scheduling agent for US wealth advisors. [UBS proprietary / Microsoft Copilot]
deployments_detail.value: ~10,000 advisor hours saved per month; 20-30 min saved per meeting; ~24,000 monthly research prompts; 95% of advisors using some AI

deployments_detail.use: Digitization of the advisory knowledge base — ~60,000 investment-advice and product documents converted into semantically searchable content to cut advisor research and meeting-prep time. [Microsoft Azure (Azure AI Search)]

GitHub Copilot for AI-augmented software development, being rolled out across Group Operations and Technology Office; experimental 'multi-player mode' letting multiple developers code together with Copilot as a contributor. [GitHub Copilot (Microsoft/OpenAI)]
